distanceRationale: Hilbert 90 and low-degree group cohomology, continuous Galois cohomology with Kummer classes, Brauer groups of fields, étale sites and K₀ exist, but there is no higher algebraic K-theory, Milnor K-theory, étale cohomology of schemes or motivic cohomology. The targets (Tate's K₂ theorem, Bloch's higher Chow groups with the moving lemma, the Rost–Voevodsky norm-residue theorem with sheaves with transfers, motivic Steenrod operations and norm varieties, the Friedlander–Suslin/Levine motivic spectral sequence and Quillen–Lichtenbaum via étale descent) are established theorems, but they rest on many research-level theories not yet built.
